parameters.content:
## Lokalise push :ticket: -> Claude (DRAFT, inactive)

Every 2 min reads 3 days of history (paginated, up to 10x200 per channel) in the 7 automation channels. A post matches when its text, attachments or blocks contain "pushed to Lokalise" (not "cleanup mode") and it has a :ticket: reaction. For each new match it posts in the thread: `@Claude run lokalise-keys-jira-trace on this push: <permalink>`, unless the thread already has that request. A post is marked done only after Slack accepts the reply.

**Before publishing:** the i18n assignment bot must be a member of all 7 channels (the live watcher gets channel_not_found on every channel) and needs channels:history, groups:history, chat:write. Claude must be in the channels too.
